lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੇਨ ਪਗ ਸਾਧਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ma(n)gai daan prabh ren pag saadhaa ||4||3||27||
lines.translation: Nanak begs God for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||3||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਭੇਜੇ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin tum bheje tinahi bulaae sukh sahaj setee ghar aau ||
lines.translation: The One who sent you, has now recalled you; return to your home now in peace and pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anad ma(n)gal gun gaau sahaj dhun nihachal raaj kamaau ||1||
lines.translation: In bliss and ecstasy, sing His Glorious Praises; by this celestial tune, you shall acquire your everlasting kingdom. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum ghar aavahu mere meet ||
lines.translation: Come back to your home, O my friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਅਪਦਾ ਭਈ ਬਿਤੀਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumare dokhee har aap nivaare apadaa bhaee biteet || rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself has eliminated your enemies, and your misfortunes are past. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਕੀਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਨੇਹਾਰੇ ਨਾਸਨ ਭਾਜਨ ਥਾਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pragat keene prabh karanehaare naasan bhaajan thaake ||
lines.translation: God, the Creator Lord, has glorified you, and your running and rushing around has ended.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਖਸਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ma(n)gal vaajahi nit vaaje apunai khasam nivaaje ||2||
lines.translation: In your home, there is rejoicing; the musical instruments continually play, and your Husband Lord has exalted you. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਰਹਹੁ ਡੋਲਹੁ ਮਤ ਕਬਹੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: asathir rahahu dolahu mat kabahoo gur kai bachan adhaar ||
lines.translation: Remain firm and steady, and do not ever waver; take the Guru's Word as your Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jai jai kaar sagal bhoo ma(n)dal mukh oojal darabaar ||3||
lines.translation: You shall be applauded and congratulated all over the world, and your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨੈ ਹੀ ਫੇਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin ke jee tinai hee phere aape bhaiaa sahaaee ||
lines.translation: All beings belong to Him; He Himself transforms them, and He Himself becomes their help and support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: acharaj keeaa karanaihaarai naanak sach vadiaaee ||4||4||28||
lines.translation: The Creator Lord has worked a wondrous miracle; O Nanak, His glorious greatness is true. ||4||4||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ghar 6 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਿਨਉ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sunahu sa(n)t piaare binau hamaare jeeu ||
lines.translation: Listen, O Dear Beloved Saints, to my prayer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin mukat na kaahoo jeeu || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord, no one is liberated. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਰਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਕਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man niramal karam kar taaran taran har avar ja(n)jaal terai kaahoo na kaam jeeu ||
lines.translation: O mind, do only deeds of purity; the Lord is the only boat to carry you across. Other entanglements shall be of no use to you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇਵਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੇਵਾ ਇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jeevan devaa paarabraham sevaa ihu upades mo kau gur deenaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: True living is serving the Divine, Supreme Lord God; the Guru has imparted this teaching to me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਨ ਲਾਈਐ ਹੀਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੀਤੁ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਓਹੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis siu na laaeeai heet jaa ko kichh naahee beet a(n)t kee baar ohu sa(n)g na chaalai ||
lines.translation: Do not fall in love with trivial things; in the end, they shall not go along with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੂ ਆਰਾਧ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਧ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: man tan too aaraadh har ke preetam saadh jaa kai sa(n)g tere ba(n)dhan chhootai ||2||
lines.translation: Worship and adore the Lord with your mind and body, O Beloved Saint of the Lord; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be released from bondage. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲ ਚਰਨ ਅਵਰ ਆਸ ਕਛੁ ਪਟਲੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gahu paarabraham saran hiradai kamal charan avar aas kachh patal na keejai ||
lines.translation: In your heart, hold fast to the Sanctuary of the lotus feet of the Supreme Lord God; do not place your hopes in any other support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਤਪਾ ਸੋਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੧॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: soee bhagat giaanee dhiaanee tapaa soee naanak jaa kau kirapaa keejai ||3||1||29||
lines.translation: He alone is a devotee, spiritually wise, a meditator, and a penitent, O Nanak, who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy. ||3||1||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਭਲੋ ਰੇ ਭਲੋ ਰੇ ਭਲੋ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere laal bhalo re bhalo re bhalo har ma(n)ganaa ||
lines.translation: O my dear beloved, it is good, it is better, it is best, to ask for the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਨੈਨ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੇ ਬੈਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਮਰਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekhahu pasaar nain sunahu saadhoo ke bain praanapat chit raakh sagal hai maranaa || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Behold, with your eyes wide-open, and listen to the Words of the Holy Saints; enshrine in your consciousness the Lord of Life - remember that all must die. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਚੋਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਤ ਅਨੇਕੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਫੀਕੇ ਏਕੈ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਕੋ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)dan choaa ras bhog karat anekai bikhiaa bikaar dekh sagal hai pheeke ekai gobid ko naam neeko kahat hai saadh jan ||
lines.translation: The application of sandalwood oil, the enjoyment of pleasures and the practice of many corrupt sins - look upon all of these as insipid and worthless. The Name of the Lord of the Universe alone is sublime; so say the Holy Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਆਪਨ ਥਾਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਨ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਾਪਿਓ ਅਰਥੁ ਦ੍ਰਬੁ ਦੇਖੁ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਲਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tan dhan aapan thaapio har jap na nimakh jaapio arath drab dekh kachh sa(n)g naahee chalanaa ||1||
lines.translation: You claim that your body and wealth are your own; you do not chant the Lord's Name even for an instant. Look and see, that none of your possessions or riches shall go along with you. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ਕਰਮੁ ਭਲਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਲਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa ko re karam bhalaa tin ot gahee sa(n)t palaa tin naahee re jam sa(n)taavai saadhoo kee sa(n)ganaa ||
lines.translation: One who has good karma, grasps the Protection of the hem of the Saint's robe; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Messenger of Death cannot threaten him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਹੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਏਕੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: paaio re param nidhaan mitio hai abhimaan ekai nira(n)kaar naanak man laganaa ||2||2||30||
lines.translation: I have obtained the supreme treasure, and my egotism has been eradicated; Nanak's mind is attached to the One Formless Lord. ||2||2||30||
